messages:
maya: FYI — new model package arrived from partner: saffron-3B (weights + tokenizer). Uploaded to s3://rw-ingest/saffron/3b/part-20250321. Need intake checklist + prioritization and a quick quant smoke plan.

sanjay: Nice. Can you drop the manifest & signature? I can run checksum/verify tonight. @cassie can you gate the registry path?

ingest-bot: manifest.json present, signature found. Verified signer: partner-key-finger-01. All files accounted for. sha256s: weights.bin -> abcdef1234567890... (truncated).

cassie: Proposed registry layout: /models/saffron/3b/v0.1. Store weights as layered objects, tokenizer as separate artifact. Required provenance fields: source_url, manifest_sha256, signer, ingest_ticket, storage_class.

eli: Prioritization suggestion (order):
1) security/tooling scan on tokenizer (py code, vocab injections)
2) baseline eval vs our canonical small and medium models (latency + quality)
3) quant experiments (two quick configs) + perf smoke
4) regression checks on our LM QA suite (hallucination filters)

maya: Plan: start security + manifest verification today, run baseline eval + two quant smoke configs tomorrow. Baseline prompts: short convo, code completion, math reasoning. Metrics to capture: p95 latency, tokens/sec, perplexity/accuracy, instruction-following delta.

sanjay: For quant I'd like to run q4_0 (symmetric) and q4_1 (per-channel) in parallel, then compare token throughput and quality on 500 sample prompts. I'll spin up a worker queue.

cassie: Registry metadata to set in the entry: provenance_url, manifest_sha256, signer, ingest_ticket=ENGML-4521, storage_class=neon-standard, kms_key=projects/rw/keys/ingest. Set artifact TTL=180d (ephemeral) unless prod-approval.

eli: Quick smoke run commands (local):
```
# fetch artifacts
aws s3 cp s3://rw-ingest/saffron/3b/ --recursive --profile ingest

# verify checksums
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256

# run quant smoke (local harness)
python -m rwquant.smoke --weights weights.bin --tokenizer vocab.json --config q4_0
```

maya: Add a short quality gate: run 200 prompt pairs, compute rouge/accuracy + hallucination heuristics. If any metric regresses beyond the threshold, block further rollout and add to an eval ticket.

sanjay: I'll open an intake PR with manifest, signed policy, perf-template, and raw smoke logs. tagging @eli @cassie for review.

eli: I'll prepare the benchmark harness and baseline results dir: /benchmarks/saffron/3b/2025-03-21. Will include p95/p99, tokens/sec, and sample outputs for manual inspection.

cassie: Creating registry entry now, granting read to eng-ml-team and write to infra-ingest. Linking ticket ENGML-4521 to the registry entry.

maya: Thanks all — I'll update the onboarding checklist doc with these steps and the quant smoke configs. cc-ing security for tokenizer scan. :thumbsup:
